title: a16z Podcast: Lessons Learned from Chinese Education Startups

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: When people talk about trends in education technology.
reader_summary.overview: When people talk about trends in education technology, they often focus on how to disrupt higher education in the U.S.. However, in China, the transformation of education is already well underway, with a fast-growing ecosystem built around lifelong learning. or will these techniques even work outside of China?
